brief:
Clashes erupted between residents and Israeli police in the Galilean town of Deir al-Asad, the Ma'an news agency reported. The confrontation followed accusations that police were obstructing voting during Israeli elections.

Details of the specific allegations and the scale of the clashes were not immediately clear. Deir al-Asad is a Palestinian Arab town in the Galilee region of northern Israel.
title: Israeli police clash with residents in Deir al-Asad over voting obstruction claims
